question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Hard and fast
solution:
The correct answer is "**Strict**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the given idiom is "**not to be modified or evaded or strict**."
 
• We use the given idiom in a situation **where some rules or something in question is rigid and cannot be changed so easily.**
 
 
• **​Example: ***Tina said, "My company has a** hard and fast **__policy when it comes to granting leaves to its employees."*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
